description: Look up ANY New York OCM cannabis license number — retail dispensary, microbusiness, cultivator, processor, distributor, registered organization — against the full OCM licensing record (3,000+ licenses), not just shops. Returns the license type, status, holder, dates, county, and for cultivators the grow method; links the matching dispensary listing and brand when we have them. A partial number, application number, or company name returns candidates in `similar`. Use it to answer "is this a real licensed NY business" and "who holds this license".

license_number.description: OCM license number (e.g. "OCM-CAURD-23-000023", "OCM-PROC-24-000096"), application number, or part of one; a company name also works

name: verify_license

brand.description: The brand catalog entry holding this license, when known

dataUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the feed this result came from: dispensary directory (OCM refresh), deals export, brand-availability export, or review index

dispensary.description: The directory listing, when the license is a retail dispensary we list

closure.description: Present only when the shop has closed

distance.description: Miles from `near`, when a near point was given

openNow.description: Open right now by posted hours (New York time); absent when hours are unknown

retailDateOpened.description: YYYY-MM-DD the shop opened to the public

licenseType.description: e.g. Adult-Use Retail Dispensary License, Adult-Use Processor License, Adult-Use Cultivator License

seeCategory.description: Social & economic equity category, when declared

licensed.description: found and the license status is Active

similar.description: Close matches when there is no exact one

source.description: Attribution line — CC BY 4.0, cite the row url

title: Verify a NY OCM cannabis license
